jobs.description:
This is a Junior position.
 About The Role
 iGATES is looking for a creative and motivated Junior UX/UI Designer to join our team on a part-time basis.
This position is suitable for a student or a designer at the beginning of their career , who is looking for hands-on experience working on real digital products and a wide range of design projects.
As the only designer in the company , you will be involved in the full design process — from initial ideas and sketches to UX, UI, prototyping and final designs ready for development.
You will work directly with the Product Manager, Development Manager, CEO and developers , and will have the opportunity to influence the products we build.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is creative, curious, independent and eager to learn .
What You'll Do
 • Design Mobile applications, Web systems and digital products.
• Turn ideas, requirements and concepts into clear and engaging design solutions.
• Create initial concepts, sketches and visual directions.
• Create User Flows, Wireframes, Mockups and Prototypes.
• Design high-fidelity UI screens using Figma.
• Create and maintain UI components and Design Systems.
• Prepare detailed designs and specifications for development.
• Design icons, illustrations and other visual assets.
• Improve and refine existing products and interfaces.
• Work closely with the Product Manager and development team throughout the development process.
• Explore different design solutions and present design concepts.
• Use AI tools to explore ideas and improve the design workflow.
• Take part in a variety of design tasks across different products and projects.
 Requirements
 • Student or Junior Designer at the beginning of their career.
• Availability for 3 days per week, part-time.
• Portfolio is required.
• Portfolio must include examples of:
 • Mobile Application design
• Website / Web design
• Logo / Branding design
• Good knowledge of Figma.
• Basic understanding of UX/UI principles.
• Ability to create Wireframes, User Flows, Mockups and Prototypes.
• Good drawing, sketching and/or illustration skills – important.
• Strong visual sense and attention to detail.
• Creative thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to receive feedback and make changes.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
• Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools and technologies.
• Good Hebrew and English.
Advantages
 • Experience with Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop.
• Experience designing Mobile applications or Web systems.
• Experience with Design Systems and reusable UI components.
• Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and development constraints.
• Experience working with developers or product teams.
• Experience with AI design tools.
• Motion design / animation skills.
Who We're Looking For
We are looking for someone with strong creative and visual abilities , who enjoys turning ideas into visual solutions and is excited to learn and develop.
You don't need to know everything yet.
What is important to us is a strong foundation, a good eye for design, creativity, curiosity and the motivation to learn .
Since you will be the only designer on the team , initiative and independence are important. We are looking for someone who is comfortable asking questions, exploring different solutions, receiving feedback and taking responsibility for their work.
An important part of the role is the ability to draw, sketch and illustrate , in addition to UX/UI design.
If you are a student or junior designer looking for an opportunity to gain real-world experience, work closely with product and development teams, and take part in a wide variety of design projects — we'd love to hear from you.
 Why Join iGATES?
 • Work on real mobile, web, and technology products.
• Work directly with the Product Manager and development team.
• Gain hands-on experience across the complete product design process.
• Develop your UX, UI, visual design, and illustration skills.
• Use modern design and AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

Description
 Shield is a global startup, with offices in TLV, NYC, LDN, and LIS. We’re growing and looking for another important piece of the puzzle.
Is it you?
We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented student to join our Data Science team for a limited-term engagement. If you have a finance background, speak multiple languages, and enjoy digging into data, this is for you!
 Let’s Get Down To Business
 About the Role
 Shield FC is a leading innovator in the financial compliance space, serving some of the world’s largest banks and financial institutions. We help these organizations meet regulatory obligations by monitoring vast volumes of employee communications.
Our Data Science team builds NLP and LLM-based solutions that detect rare and subtle indicators of suspicious behavior hidden in massive streams of text. High-quality annotated data is the foundation of everything we build, and that’s where you come in. As a Data Labeling Specialist, you’ll use your financial and linguistic expertise to label, review, and analyze real-world communication data, directly shaping the accuracy of our models.
 What You’ll Do
 • Annotate and label financial communication data (text, and potentially transcribed audio) according to defined guidelines and taxonomies 
• Apply your financial knowledge to identify and classify relevant terminology, context, and potentially risky behaviors 
• Work with data in multiple languages, ensuring consistent and accurate labeling across them 
• Analyze annotated datasets to identify patterns, edge cases, ambiguities, and quality issues 
• Provide feedback on annotation guidelines and help refine them 
• Review and validate annotations for consistency and quality 
• Summarize your findings and insights for the Data Science team 
• Collaborate with data scientists and domain experts to improve data quality and model performance 
 Additional Details
 • Part-time, fixed-term temporary contract (approximately 100 hours per month) 
• Duration: 3 months 
• Location: 3 office days per week in our Ramat Gan office 
 Requirements
 Requirements
 • Currently enrolled in a BA/BSc or MA/MSc program in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, or a related field 
• Fluency in English and at least one additional language: [Spanish, German, French, Portuguese] 
• Strong understanding of financial concepts and terminology - Financial markets experience (or education). 
• Exceptional attention to detail and a high level of accuracy 
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to spot patterns in data 
• Ability to follow detailed guidelines while using sound judgment on ambiguous cases 
• Ability to commit to 100 hours a month for 3 months, working 3 days a week from the office 
• Team player 
 Advantages -
 • Familiarity with financial compliance, regulation, or market surveillance 
• Experience in a large investment bank front office environment is a huge advantage 
• Experience in compliance for top tier investment bank is a big advantage 
• Basic experience with Python, SQL, or data analysis tools 
• Previous experience in data annotation, labeling, or research 
• Interest in AI, NLP, and LLMs

Overview
 Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft with thousands of University interns from every corner of the world. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential—and excitement for the journey ahead.
As a Security Research Intern, under supervision you will design and conduct security research including malware analysis, threat and vulnerability analysis, adversary tracking, threat intelligence, detection and remediation development and other technology application focuses related to the understanding of the threat landscape with intent to disrupt adversaries or provide protection via defensive products and services. You will help generate solutions including first party mitigation and working closely with customers and partners and support operational security and security incidents as well as security reviews and reporting.
We are building a cutting-edge Cloud solution that gives customers visibility and control without impeding agility and helps them stay ahead of cyber threats as they evolve. You will join the group that is responsible for advanced threat detection capabilities, leveraging machine learning and behavioral profiling to detect emerging threats and advanced attacks by engineering a hyper-scale service to defend millions of hosts.
At Microsoft, Interns work on real-world projects in collaboration with teams across the world, while having fun along the way. You’ll be empowered to build community, explore your passions and achieve your goals. This is your chance to bring your solutions and ideas to life while working on cutting-edge technology.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
 Responsibilities
 • Begin to analyze threat trends and anomalies to determine operational impact. Determine vectors that introduce threat and potential mitigation strategies. Learn about systemic security issues and how to address them.
• Process threat reporting from internal and external sources. Provide discrete threat data based on intelligence requirements or customer requests.
• Identify security defects or vulnerabilities and deficiencies in security guidance.
• Contribute code to technical implementation and automation of solutions to address security issues, such as signature detection, malware, threat analysis, or reverse engineering. Use results from research and experimentation to support architecture or product direction.
• Identify areas of dependency and overlap with other teams or team members. Provide constructive input so the work is integrated and timely. Communicate the status of deliverables and dependencies to meet schedule.
• Engage in measures to protect tools, techniques, information, and results of security practices. Respond to incidents for systems or products as needed. Use results of pen testing to improve products and services.
• This student position is structured as a one-and-a-half-year role, concluding upon completion of the academic degree.
 Qualifications
 • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field, with an expected graduation date of Summer 2028 or later.
• 2+ years of hands-on experience in security research or threat hunting, with a specialized focus on identity, cloud, or AI-based threat scenarios.
• Deep understanding of the threat landscape, including modern attacker techniques and complex kill-chains, with a focus on platform internals across OS, Cloud Workloads and Identity platforms.
• Experience hunting across diverse signal sources, effectively uncovering threats within on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Summary
 As a member of our ML group, you will design, prototype, and ship agentic GenAI systems used by chip design engineers to accelerate their day-to-day workflows. We are looking for a machine learning engineer who is energized by taking LLMs from "promising demo" to "depended-on tool": designing the agent loops, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation frameworks that make this transition real. Success in this role means agents that meaningfully shift how our customer teams work, backed by measurements you trust.
 Description
 You will join a growing team of ML and software engineers building GenAI solutions for chip design teams. In this role, you will:
Design and build agentic systems featuring multi-agent coordination, long-horizon reasoning, tool use, and planning frameworks.
Develop end-to-end solutions, including domain-specific agents and high-performance retrieval pipelines spanning diverse data sources.
Partner with subject-matter experts on the customer teams to translate their workflows and rules of thumb into concrete agent assignments, prompts, tools, and guidelines.
